newsitem.title: USA: Midland Resources had gain on property sale.
newsitem.headline: Midland Resources had gain on property sale.

text.p: Midland Resources Inc said Monday it had a gain of about $350,000 on the sale of its interests in the Redfish Bay Field near Corpus Christi, Texas.
The company said it closed the sale to an undisclosed private company for $1,725,000 with an effective date of sale is February 1, 1997.
Chief executive Deas H. Warley stated, "Downsizing our Gulf Coast operations will enable increased focus on 3D seismic exploration and development in West Texas.
"Based on our experience to date, we anticipate the potential financial impact of the West Texas activities is significantly greater than the Gulf Coast potential."

The company noted it completed a discovery well in the West Texas Sunburst project in December and said it is in the process of completing potential discovery wells in two additional West Texas projects.

"With successful completions, we anticipate development of the projects will require additional drilling. We are also assessing potential for additional development in the recently acquired Colorado DJ Basin properties," Warley said.
